notes: Site is a Shopify store (thedecorkart.com); direct HTTP fetch worked throughout, no Playwright/Claude-in-Chrome needed. /collections/new-arrivals is a genuine, nav-linked New Arrivals PLP (homepage 'At a Glance' tab, mega-menu promo card) with a real product grid, and its own page declares 5 genuine per-category children via an on-page 'shop by category' collection-card slider: Decor/Kitchen/Furniture/Lighting/Wall Decor New Arrivals -- kept as group+leaves. A 6th similarly-named collection, 'Bath Decor New Arrivals' (bath-decor-new-arrivals, collections.json products_count=19), exists in the site's collections.json but is NOT one of the children shown on the New Arrivals hub page's slider and was not found linked from any nav, mega-menu, or hub page checked -- excluded as an orphaned/undeclared collection, consistent with the many orphaned marketing/filter collections this site is known to carry per the prior Home-Decor extraction pass on the same company. All qty values are exact counts from exhaustive /collections/<handle>/products.json pagination (limit=250) deduped by product id; collections.json's products_count field is confirmed inflated for every collection here (e.g. new-arrivals claims 777 vs 597 real, decor-new-arrivals claims 313 vs 9 real) and was not used, matching this site's known inflation pattern from the prior pass.
